facts.fact: Space in Africa, citing the Ministry of Digital Economy, reports Starlink and the CAF government signed an agreement at a ceremony hosted by the President (article dated 2025-12-23) under which Starlink's network is to be made commercially available in CAF for the first time; the document calls it an agreement, not a licence; pricing not yet disclosed.

note: Agreement is described as enabling future commercial availability; no sale stated as having begun.
